Profile: requests summed over every model and folded by UTC hour over 7 days of the series; profile[h] is UTC hour h. The simulator starts at 00:00 UTC, so a start at another hour shifts demand against the seats by that many hours.
Demand includes non-anthropic models (gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, kimi-k3:cloud, deepseek-v4.1-flash:cloud, gpt-6-luna, deepseek-v4-pro:0813-cloud): 0.0% of requests, which spend no seat quota.
Requests per day 7830 from usage-history 1d (7830 requests over 1 day); the series' 7-day mean is 11757.
Token sizes per request from usage-history 1d: input 747, output 852, prefix.start = cache read 182922, prefix.perRequest = cache write 7652.
prefix.max ASSUMED max(2 x prefix.start, 350000): the prefix cap is not recorded.
noSessionShare 0: 0 of 48 recent /messages log entries had no session id (count_tokens is not logged, so requests outside sessions may be undercounted).
sessionsPerDay 117 from health balance.placements.lastDay.placed (117); it is above the floor 97 that keeps requestChance <= 0.6.
sessionMinutes ASSUMED [30, 240]: session lengths are not recorded.
requestChance = requestsPerDay x (1 - noSessionShare) / (sessionsPerDay x 135) = 0.496, clamped to [0.05, 1].
noSessionCost = 1.25 x freshInput + 5 x output (cost weights: input 1, output 5, cache write 1.25, cache read 0.1).
Demand is pool-wide: the views carry no per-seat demand.
serviceSeconds 3.6 from health performance.pool.p50Ms.
config.throttle has no maxWaitMs; the throttle.ts default 20000 is used.
